h1: How does the Massachusetts HIC arbitration and Guaranty Fund protect homeowners?
title: Massachusetts HIC Arbitration and Guaranty Fund: Homeowner Protections
description: Review the state contract, arbitration, and Guaranty Fund protections that may apply when a registered contractor does home-improvement work.
short_answer: Massachusetts provides an HIC arbitration and Guaranty Fund process for eligible homeowners who have a qualifying dispute with a registered home-improvement contractor. The Guaranty Fund recovery is capped at $10,000 for actual loss. State law also requires covered home-improvement contracts over $1,000 to be in writing.

facts.text: Massachusetts regulations state that an eligible claimant may recover once up to, and no more than, $10,000 from the Guaranty Fund for actual loss.
Massachusetts requires home-improvement contracts over $1,000 to be in writing.

qa.q: Can every homeowner recover $10,000 from the HIC Guaranty Fund?
qa.a: No. The fund has eligibility requirements, and the $10,000 figure is a maximum recovery for eligible claims, not an automatic payment.
